summary.headline: Maine passes first statewide data-center pause — Reversion ticks up
summary.body: A busy but gentle opening day. Maine's legislature passed the first statewide moratorium on large data centers, pausing approvals for sites over 20 MW until October 2027. That is a clear sign of Tech Backlash, the factor behind Reversion, the ending where people turn away from advanced technology. OpenAI released a cyber-tuned model, GPT-5.4-Cyber, but only to vetted defenders and agencies; keeping a risky tool on a short leash slightly strengthens Alignment & Control, nudging Protector God and Gatekeeper up and Conquerors down. Novo Nordisk said its company-wide OpenAI rollout will slow hiring, a small dent in Shared Prosperity that trims Egalitarian Utopia. A German brain-implant firm, CorTec, prepared its third stroke patient. Horizon Balance reads +3.55, up 0.05.
summary.movers_note: Reversion +0.5, almost all from Maine's data-center moratorium (+0.48). Egalitarian Utopia -0.1 after Novo Nordisk's hiring warning (-0.10), while Protector God +0.1 on OpenAI's gated cyber-model release (+0.07).

events.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.4-Cyber only to vetted security researchers and agencies
events.summary: OpenAI released a cybersecurity-tuned model with relaxed guardrails but restricted access to vetted defenders and government agencies because of misuse risk.
events.reason: Gated release of a dual-use cyber model is a modest control measure; existence of the capability nudges risk.

events.title: Maine legislature passes first statewide moratorium on large data centers
events.summary: Maine's House (79-62) and Senate (21-13) passed a bill pausing approvals for data centers over 20 MW until October 2027 while a council studies grid, bill, air and water impacts.
events.reason: First US state legislature to pass a data-center moratorium is a notable backlash milestone; state-level scope.

events.title: Novo Nordisk partners with OpenAI, says AI will slow future hiring
events.summary: Novo Nordisk announced a company-wide OpenAI deployment across drug discovery and operations and said AI would slow future hiring.
events.reason: Large European employer signalling AI-driven hiring slowdown; words not cuts.

events.title: CorTec prepares third stroke patient implant of its Brain Interchange BCI
events.summary: German firm CorTec readied its brain-computer interface for a third stroke patient after early results showed improved hand and arm function.
events.reason: Incremental BCI clinical progress outside the US.
